title: Migrate custom scalar mappings and comparers
goal: Preserve custom scalar query, persistence and change tracking when upgrading an EF extension.

selectionNotes: Use the public relational mapping plugin boundary. EF11 adds generic mapping bases whose default comparer creation can use the closed CLR type; the non-generic EF10 base remains the comparison. A mutable Reading still needs an explicit snapshot and value equality comparer: generic defaults cannot infer application semantics. The mapping converts Reading to int and preserves that converter and comparer through Clone. CoreTypeMapping.Clone parameters move from in to by-value in the pinned contracts; the relational Clone override shown takes RelationalTypeMappingParameters by value in both. JSON structural type mapping describes object/collection structure; it is not the scalar mapping used here. No JSON graph or NativeAOT compatibility follows from this sample.
